title: Mixing: Walls And Bridges by John Lennon | 1974
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producer: John Lennon

A mixing session for John Lennon’s Walls And Bridges album was held on 26 September 1974.

This was the fourth of six sessions in which the album was mixed in quadrophonic.
